prompt: Small chibi cicada insect, plump body of dull bronze metal with a lighter bronze belly, two big round dark eyes, short legs. Its two wing cases are raised up and held open above its back like a pair of big bronze plates, clearly lifted away from the body, with pale glassy wings under them. 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, the raised bronze wing cases tremble slightly above its back, body breathes; wing cases stay raised
direction_prompts.west: facing left, the raised bronze wing cases tremble slightly above its back, body breathes; wing cases stay raised
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, the raised bronze wing cases tremble slightly, body breathes; wing cases stay raised
direction_prompts.east: facing right, the raised bronze wing cases tremble slightly above its back, body breathes; wing cases stay raised

follow.action_description: scuttles and short-flies forward in quick low hops, the raised bronze wing cases buzzing and vibrating, staying lifted above the back

direction_prompts.south: scuttles toward the viewer in short quick hops, compact and narrow, the raised wing cases vibrate and stay lifted
direction_prompts.west: scuttles to the left in short quick hops, the raised wing cases vibrate and stay lifted
direction_prompts.north: scuttles away from the viewer, seen from behind, compact and narrow, the raised wing cases vibrate
direction_prompts.east: scuttles to the right in short quick hops, the raised wing cases vibrate and stay lifted
